# Bun configurable compact kit

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

When a Bun property descriptor is marked configurable, the source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the property name, source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the configurable behavior, and source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the runtime impact are needed to understand the property.

Search intents:
- bun configurable property descriptor
- bun inspector runtime

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/bun-configurable --json
